title: Assess manual daily Solana candidate discovery and address-analysis task boundaries
objective: Produce a bounded task decomposition for manually supplied daily popular-token candidates and subsequent address analysis. Separate safe manual steps from later evidence work, identify dependencies and fail-closed boundaries, and record only genuine Owner decision points. Do not enable, implement, schedule, or run automated discovery.
forbidden_actions: Do not implement or enable cron, scheduler, background loops, automatic token discovery, automatic daily runs, database writes, cache writes, provider changes, or non-Solana chains.
Do not call Helius or any other provider and do not require or inspect a runtime credential.
Do not print, store, commit, or record credentials, bearer values, raw provider payloads, or credential-bearing URLs.
